newsitem.title: USA: Kinark to buy rest of Rogers Galvanizing.
newsitem.headline: Kinark to buy rest of Rogers Galvanizing.

text.p: Kinark Corp said Friday it has filed for a rights offering and plans to use the proceeds to buy about 31 percent of the outstanding capital stock of Rogers Galvanizing Co.
The rights offering is to be extended to stockholders of record on September 27 for one nontransferable right for each one share of common stock.

Each right will entitle the holder to purchase one share of common stock, the company said. The rights can be exercised for a 30-day period after the registration statement is put into effect by the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Kinark said it plans to use the proceeds to buy 31 percent of Rogers Galvanizing, which operates four plants in Tulsa and one in Kansas City.
Earlier this year, Kinark had purchased about 70 percent of Rogers Galvanizing. This deal, if completed, would make Rogers Galvanizing a wholly owned subsidiary.
